review.note: The announced contributed-project security release landed. Twenty-three advisories numbered SA-CONTRIB-2026-154 to SA-CONTRIB-2026-178 entered the first page of the listing: twenty for Webform, two for Cloud and one for Project Browser. Four are rated Critical, including two remote code execution advisories for Cloud, one remote code execution advisory for Webform and a cross-site request forgery advisory for Project Browser. Twenty-three older entries numbered SA-CONTRIB-2026-104 to SA-CONTRIB-2026-126 left the first page; that is pagination, not retraction, and none of them may be treated as withdrawn. Drupal Knowledge holds no advisory record for any of the three affected projects and none of the new advisories exists in the corpus, so this is new-record work rather than a change to an existing conclusion. New advisory records require the reviewed security ingest, not an acquisition merge.

summary: Registered source content changed. A human review must decide whether trusted Drupal knowledge is affected.
